name: 2013 S. Indiana Avenue — the alley building of the house at 2013 (district draft; refined by T-1946)

grade.why: Known from maps or written records; no picture of it has been found.

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-3009 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

placement.position_note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 0.500, v -3.000 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation 179.151 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.
placement.symbolic_location: 2013 S. Indiana Avenue, parcel indiana_2013 (data/street_grid/1904.json), east side of Indiana Avenue, the background behind Prairie Avenue: Indiana Avenue's east frontage, 20th to 22nd Street, and East Twenty-first Street's lots behind its 2101-2105 corner (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35).

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: The census reading 'Brick stable (crossed) on the alley': 1 storeys.

construction.note: The trace's fabric colour on the main part: brick.

parts.from: s35wfp-indiana_2013-b2 outline (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 79% of its fill

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): s35wfp-indiana_2013-b2 outline (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 79% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: A background house with no named record and no register row: the brick family's hip over the sheet's printed storeys, every face closed, nothing read beyond the sheet. 3B with a 2B rear part: the rounded stone bay on its Indiana front stands as the draft's projecting bay, one of the row of nine the sheet draws from 2007 to 2027. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 1742855581 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-district-background-3009.

draft.note: The draft's own provenance: the pass that wrote it, the rows it read and the tickets that replace it attribute by attribute under this id.

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads 'Brick stable (crossed) on the alley'. Drawn as a stable in 1911; the 1904 envelope is the 1911 one.

citations.citation: Sanborn Map Company. Insurance Maps of Chicago, Illinois, Volume 3. New York: Sanborn Map Company, 1911. Sheet 35.
what_it_supplies: Footprints, lots and street widths from 20th to 22nd Street between Indiana and Calumet, as of 1911, at the copy's coarser resolution
The position of Twentieth Street, which is vacated between Indiana and Calumet today
what_it_does_not_supply: Anything as of 1904 on its own authority. It is a 1911 survey; Glessner House's reading that everything on sheets 20, 28 and 35 but 1609-1611 and 1620 Prairie stood in 1904 is attributed guidance, recorded in that README, and not checked by this record
A construction date for any building it draws
Elevations, grades, curb heights or fill depths -- no Sanborn sheet carries a level
Architecture above the footprint beyond its story count, material colour and roof symbol
Any lake edge: the sheet ends at Calumet Avenue

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3009, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35w trace (s35wfp-indiana_2013-b2), the T-3009 census (s35w-2013-rear) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35w-2013; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-background-3009).
